messages:
ivy: hey folks, new joiner here. trying to build the runtime with meson on Ubuntu 22.04 + CUDA 12.1. the build finishes but running the test binary fails with: `/usr/bin/ld: third_party/libcublas.a(cublas.o): relocation R_X86_64_32 against .rodata cannot be used when making a shared object; recompile with -fPIC`

ivy: I grabbed the prebuilt third_party libs from the repo to save time. is there a quick fix other than rebuilding everything?

tom: welcome! :wave: that error means the static lib was compiled without PIC and you're linking it into a shared object. short term you can try linking the shared versions (.so) instead of the static .a if they exist.

sara: if the prebuilt folder doesn't have .so, you either rebuild the problematic lib with -fPIC or adjust meson to prefer shared libs: set `-Ddefault_library=shared` when configuring. also ensure meson passes PIC flags: `-Dc_args=-fPIC -Dc_link_args=-fPIC` (or `-Dcpp_args` for C++ parts).

ivy: I checked `third_party/linux-x86_64` and only .a files are present. tried `meson configure build` to add `-Ddefault_library=shared` but meson still picks static libs from that folder.

tom: meson will prefer static if only static is available. Two options: rebuild third_party lib from source with PIC, or create a small shim shared lib that links the static lib with -fPIC (not ideal). Rebuilding is the clean path.

ivy: how do you usually rebuild those deps quickly? any scripts?

sara: we have `third_party/build_deps.sh` in the repo root for common deps. try `./third_party/build_deps.sh cublas-lite --prefix=third_party/local` (adjust name). After that point meson should pick libs from `third_party/local/lib` if you update `PKG_CONFIG_PATH` or pass `-Dthird_party_prefix=third_party/local` to meson.

infra-bot: [infra-bot] Note: CI artifacts include prebuilt third_party with PIC. Use CI image tag `eng-runtime/dev:2026-02-01` if you want prebuilt PIC libs locally.

ivy: sweet, I don't want to rebuild 20 packages. I can try the CI image. how do I run it?

tom: run `docker run --rm -it --gpus all -v $(pwd):/work -w /work eng-runtime/dev:2026-02-01 /bin/bash` then inside run the normal build steps. the image already has gcc-9 and PIC-built third_party.

ivy: launched and build + tests inside container pass. :tada: thanks. I'll open a short PR documenting the meson flags and linking note for prebuilt libs so future new hires don't hit this.

sara: awesome. also add a note to README about preferring `eng-runtime/dev:...` image for quick onboarding. CI image tag is stable for a month; ping eng-runtime-oncall if it rotates.

eng-runtime-oncall: ping me when you open the doc PR and I'll link to the verified image in the onboarding checklist. happy to share a temp VM if you want to experiment with toolchain variants.

ivy: will do, thanks everyone — super helpful and fast! :relieved:
